description: This file defines reflection-based optional value encoders and decoders for JSON serialization, including handling of nil pointers and pointer dereferencing.

classes.name: OptionalDecoder
classes.description: Decoder for optional (pointer) types, handling nil values and memory allocation.

classes.name: dereferenceDecoder
classes.description: Decoder that dereferences a pointer before decoding.

classes.name: OptionalEncoder
classes.description: Encoder for optional (pointer) types, handling nil values.

classes.name: dereferenceEncoder
classes.description: Encoder that dereferences a pointer before encoding.

classes.name: referenceEncoder
classes.description: Encoder that references a value pointer.

classes.name: referenceDecoder
classes.description: Decoder that references a value pointer.

methods.name: decoderOfOptional
methods.description: Creates a decoder for optional types based on the element type.

methods.name: encoderOfOptional
methods.description: Creates an encoder for optional types based on the element type.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes data into a pointer, handling nil and memory allocation.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a pointer value, writing nil if the pointer is nil.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the pointer is nil.
